5.0.SP2.description: Used to indicate that a message is being sent in response to an Application Message Request <BW> . It is possible for both ApplResendFlag <1352> and PossDupFlag <43> to be set on the same message if the Sender's cache size is greater than zero and the message is being resent due to a session level resend request
